label: Vertical arrows
intent: It extends up and down. Light: the two halves launch outward from the middle, each along its own head, and fade before the edges; a fresh pair grows back out of the middle, lands just past rest and settles. Strong: they pull in first, then launch farther while a fading shaft keeps them joined, so the arrow stretches before it goes, and the fresh pair lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. v1's single shaft is split at the middle so each half travels with its head; at rest it draws the same.

stretch.//: hidden at rest: v1's shaft line, left behind while the halves fly apart so the arrow reads as stretching
